target_customer: Parents of children in grades 3 to 8 in India who pay fees for live online group learning
problem: Indian school children get little personal coaching or mastery-based progression in large classes or recorded video courses.
business_model: B2C tuition fees for cohort-based online classes, later a full remote school with annual fee
product_category: K-12 online group coaching and remote school

founders.name: Shankar Ram A
prior_employers: BYJU'S (first product manager, later Senior Director of Product and Innovation)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page bio, which is truncated.

founders.name: Aanand Srinivas
founders.background_notes: Prior role from the company website, not the YC page.

founders.name: Avinash Anand
founders.background_notes: No background given on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A live class platform with coach tooling and content is standard web engineering. The hard part is pedagogy and content, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Curriculum and coach quality can be copied by other edtech players, and no network effect or lock-in is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large Indian edtech players already sold live online classes; no source shows them copying or buying StayQrious.

market_need_then: Indian online K-12 demand rose sharply in 2020 as schools closed for COVID-19. The company launched around March 2020. No dated demand figure was sourced.

identity.logo: A Q motif is shown on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, punchy statements aimed at parents that challenge conventional schooling

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand itself beyond funding news. The playful Qrious spelling is distinctive but invites misspelling.

pivots.to: StayQrious Neoschool, a fully remote project-based school for grades 3 to 8
pivots.why: Not stated; the current website presents the school offering. Date unknown.

outcome_analysis: StayQrious raised a roughly $2M seed in September 2020 during the COVID online learning surge and is still active, with a reported team of 29. The current site sells a remote school with a high annual fee rather than the original group classes. No later round, exit, or layoff was found, so the long term outcome is unclear and no success or failure factor is well supported.
notes: Seed confirmed by several outlets (YourStory, Inc42, others) that likely share one press release. CB Insights total of 2.15M or 2.12M is unverified. No dated 2020 competitor sources were found, only current alternatives lists, so the list is empty. Outcome search found no news on layoffs, acquisition or shutdown. Team size 29 on YC vs a founder bio claiming 150 plus.
